args: 7_henri decaë's black-and-white cinematography brings out the melancholy mystery of paris' boulevards and cafes, and ms. moreau, shot with natural lighting and without make-up, is like a mournful goddess of glamour.
10_the movie's most compelling element of all is moreau, wandering the nighttime streets trying to find her lover.

15_what makes this swooningly atmospheric movie a true romance is the face of jeanne moreau in close-up, at once impassive, devious and tragic as she wanders the rain-soaked streets of nighttime paris.
17_don't miss this opportunity to see the movie that launched the legend of jeanne moreau.
